issue_context.title: ImmutableArray.CastUp and Cast should be annotated with `class?`
issue_context.body:
### Description

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/master/src/libraries/System.Collections.Immutable/src/System/Collections/Immutable/ImmutableArray_1.Minimal.cs#L327
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/master/src/libraries/System.Collections.Immutable/src/System/Collections/Immutable/ImmutableArray_1.Minimal.cs#L347

Both of these methods are annotated as `where TOther : class`. However, it's perfectly reasonable to substitute a nullable type for `TOther` there, and they should be annotated as `class?` because of it.
